t: Hub folder/structure evolution for canonical Wheelwright
description: Evolve hub directory structure to support canonical Wheelwright model. Current hub has minimal structure (symlink to framework teachings). Canonical hub needs: teachings_repo/ for multi-spoke distribution, signals/incoming/ and signals/processed/ for signal routing, lugs/inbox/ for lug delivery, registry/ for spoke tracking, and metadata for hub operations.
problem_statement: Hub structure was designed pre-canonical. Needs evolution to support: multi-spoke teaching distribution (no symlinks), signal routing, lug inbox, spoke registry, hub metadata tracking.

signals/.incoming/: High-impact lugs (impact >= 8) from spokes awaiting processing
signals/.processed/: Archive of processed signals with timestamps

execution_sequence: 1. Create hub directory structure (mkdir -p for all canonical dirs)
4. Implement lug inbox for inter-spoke communication
5. Implement spoke registry with provenance tracking
6. Update all spoke closeouts to use new hub structure
7. Migrate existing hub data to canonical structure
success_criteria: All spokes use hub for teaching distribution (no symlinks)
Signal routing operational (high-impact lugs flow through hub)
Spoke registry tracks active spokes and their teachings
migration_safe: New structure additive - old symlink approach continues working during transition
